en: Color postcard showing an ornate stone gate with two pillars topped by potted plants. Between the pillars is a wrought‑iron archway reading "NUOVO STABILIMENTO BAGNI." Through the open gate, a landscaped garden leads to a large, elegant spa or hotel building set against tree‑covered hills. At the bottom margin of the image appears the caption "LEVICO - Entrata allo Stabilimento nuovo," along with a small publisher's credit and number.
